profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at ZeroFox
profile.summary: I am driven to high standards in my work. I am highly organized, usually fixing systems I come into contact with. I easily learn new skills necessary to complete the project I have started. I am task-oriented, gaining satisfaction from finishing tasks and overall projects. I can work tirelessly on projects that interest me. My primary objective is to work in an environment where I am self-driven and am able to make a real positive difference in the lives of those I meet.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Working at the cutting edge of the AISDLC

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managed Technology BU budget
Managed 11 engineers across SRE, Data Engineering, and AI tooling developer experience teams
Managed AI tooling adoption across Tech BU
Managed roadmaps and accountable for delivery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Mentoring · Scrum Master · DevOps · Software Development · Team Management

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Having been brought in at the intern level at Agile in August, 2015, after completing the requirements for my AAS degree in Computer Programming with Applications Development, I was subsequently offered a full-time position after only a couple of months, and accepted a position as Software Developer in October, 2015.  While working in this position, I was fortunate to be working in both team settings writing business applications for web and mobile on the .NET framework, and have had the opportunity to regularly take on projects where I was able to independently design the architecture and implement database design on a multi-tier application. As a part of my responsibilities at Agile I was tasked with training new hires on standards and new technologies including virtual reality applications.  Having been exposed to multiple platforms while working for Agile, I have become proficient in C#, Javascript, HTML, CSS, and have developed software and code with Angular JS, MVC, MVVM, Web API, .NET 2.0 - 4.5, Unity in my experience here as well.

positions.title: Territory Manager
positions.description: As the territory manager, for the largest national retailer of hot tubs, I was charged with opening operations for the manufacturer in the Northwest, and for the entire sales process from initial contact to order fulfillment.  My responsibilities included finding, opening and overseeing warehouse and show room operations, educating customers on the health benefits of hydro therapy, providing detailed information on the features and upgrades available, processing and tracking the entire purchase, and coordinating delivery by professional spa delivery personnel.

positions.title: Website Designer
positions.description: As a website designer I have designed websites for clients on an independent, freelance basis, regularly implementing the use of CSS, PHP, HTML, Gimp, and WordPress in development of websites based on the individual client needs.  I also became the de facto webmaster for my regular clients by maintaining and updating their websites, as well as keeping them secure.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description: On-site and remote access services as part of a team of technicians. Troubleshooting and repairing customers personal and business problems both hardware and software. Configured new systems and  setup networks.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Programming: Applications Development - Microsoft C++

volunteerExperiences.description:
My volunteer work at Keep San Marcos Beautiful was between 12-15 hours per week with extra hours during special events. I assisted Amy Kirwin, the Program Manager, with almost every aspect of KSMB while I was there. We enjoyed working together and organized various events to promote KSMB initiatives, worked booths to bring awareness, coordinated volunteers for KSMB programs, educated local children about recycling, and wrote grants for support.

KSMB about page: http://www.ci.san-marcos.tx.us/index.aspx?page=926
Volunteered for various United Way programs including food drives, shoe drives, clothes drives, etc.
